name: Go North
description:
About This Game

It is not very often I see a Littler attempt to Go North. Tell me, little one, what motivates you? It is said that the Maze God resides at the northernmost part of the world and that he grants one wish to any adventurer brave and clever enough to reach him… could that be you?

Embark on a cozy and immersive maze adventure as Dara seeks to make her one wish come true. With the help of numerous magical and technological items, navigate beautifully unique labyrinthine environments and explore expansive worlds in a story-driven adventure that prioritizes peace over progress.

Guide Dara through diverse mazes purposefully crafted by the Maze Makers to test her perseverance. But something sinister seems to be corrupting the mazes. Something… or someone.

  • Navigate beautiful mazes in 3rd person: walk around atmospheric and gorgeous levels while discovering different items, characters, puzzles and stories.

  • Use unique and helpful items scattered around each maze ranging from simple items like a hoverboard to more elaborate items like a robot mouse that scurries towards the exit.

  • Solve puzzles and avoid obstacles: use your wits to solve the different puzzles and obstacles within each maze. Decipher different riddles and clues to uncover secret passages, items and easter eggs.

  • Wander through an infinite amount of cleverly generated mazes of varying forms and worlds in Arcade Mode.

  • Accessorize Dara’s outfit with hats, scarves, goggles, backpacks, and other undiscovered treasures.

  • Discover the elusive Golden Compass locations in each maze.
short_desc: Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and narrative-driven adventure!
